remarks: This exquisite 5-bedroom, 4.5-bath home with elevator is ideally located directly in the heart of New Canaan, offering true in-town living with shops, restaurants, train station, and everyday amenities right at your fingertips. Meticulously designed and crafted by a renowned local builder, this residence offers a fresh, like-new feel throughout with an open-concept floor plan, 9-foot ceilings, 4 impeccably finished levels, and abundant natural light. At the center of the home is a stunning chef's kitchen featuring premium Thermador appliances, quartz counters, custom cabinetry, generous prep space, and bar area with wine cooler. The main level flows beautifully between the kitchen, dining, and living areas, highlighted by a gas/wood fireplace and refined finishes throughout. Additional features include a 2-car garage, custom elevator, generator, security system, and beautifully landscaped and fenced-in yard with patio and underground sprinklers. The primary suite features a walk-in closet with built-ins and a spa-like bath with soaking tub. Each additional bedroom is thoughtfully designed with ample closet space, and the finished 4th floor and lower level provide versatile spaces for an office, gym, playroom, guest area, or media room. Whether hosting gatherings or enjoying everyday life, this home delivers the best of New Canaan living right at your doorstep.
